steps.en: Notices waiting for owner lookup are picked up automatically, twice a day
steps.id: Notice yang menunggu data pemilik diambil otomatis, dua kali sehari

steps.en: Vehicle numbers are packed into a request file and sent to the agency
steps.id: Nomor kendaraan dikemas dalam file permintaan dan dikirim ke agency

steps.en: The agency result file is read and each record is understood
steps.id: File hasil dari agency dibaca dan tiap record dipahami

steps.en: The owner's ID number, ID type and name are saved on the notice
steps.id: Nomor ID, jenis ID, dan nama pemilik disimpan di notice

steps.en: The owner's registered and mailing addresses are saved on the notice
steps.id: Alamat terdaftar dan alamat surat pemilik disimpan di notice

steps.en: The notice moves on to follow-up once the owner is known
steps.id: Notice lanjut ke tindak lanjut setelah pemilik diketahui
steps.why_en: Notices are moved forward when the request is sent, so some continue without any owner data.
steps.why_id: Notice sudah dimajukan saat permintaan dikirim, jadi sebagian lanjut tanpa data pemilik.
